package optionalreport_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	server "example.com/optionalreport/gen/jsonrpc/probe/server"
	probe "example.com/optionalreport/gen/probe"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/jsonrpc"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

type (
	failureEncoder struct {
		err error
	}
	failureContextKey struct {
	}
)

func TestOptionalFailureReporting(t *testing.T) {
	for _, entry := range []string{"mounted", "direct"} {
		for _, provided := range []bool{false, true} {
			for _, mode := range []string{"decode-notification", "endpoint-notification", "decode-request", "endpoint-request", "result-encode", "empty-encode", "error-encode", "object-encode", "success"} {
				name := entry + "/nil/" + mode
				if provided {
					name = entry + "/provided/" + mode
				}
				t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
					calls, reports, encodes := 0, 0, 0
					cause := errors.New("private source error")
					method := "call"
					if mode == "empty-encode" {
						method = "nothing"
					}
					if strings.HasPrefix(mode, "object-") {
						method = "object"
					}
					endpoint := func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
						calls++
						if strings.HasPrefix(mode, "endpoint-") || mode == "error-encode" {
							return nil, cause
						}
						if method == "object" {
							return &probe.ObjectResult{Value: "ok", Header: "header"}, nil
						}
						if method == "nothing" {
							return nil, nil
						}
						return "ok", nil
					}
					encoder := func(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter) loomhttp.Encoder {
						encodes++
						if strings.HasSuffix(mode, "encode") {
							return failureEncoder{err: cause}
						}
						return loomhttp.ResponseEncoder(ctx, w)
					}
					response := httptest.NewRecorder()
					var handler func(context.Context, http.ResponseWriter, error)
					if provided {
						handler = func(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
							reports++
							require.Equal(t, "marker", ctx.Value(failureContextKey{}))
							if strings.HasPrefix(mode, "decode-") {
								var validation *loom.ServiceError
								require.ErrorAs(t, err, &validation)
							} else {
								require.ErrorIs(t, err, cause)
							}
							if entry == "direct" {
								require.Same(t, response, w)
							} else if strings.HasSuffix(mode, "notification") {
								_, writeErr := w.Write([]byte("diagnostic callback output"))
								require.NoError(t, writeErr)
							}
						}
					}
					id := `,"id":"one"`
					if strings.HasSuffix(mode, "notification") {
						id = ""
					}
					params := `{"value":"ok"}`
					if strings.HasPrefix(mode, "decode-") {
						params = `{}`
					}
					body := `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"` + method + `","params":` + params + id + `}`
					request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/rpc", strings.NewReader(body))
					request = request.WithContext(context.WithValue(request.Context(), failureContextKey{}, "marker"))
					request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
					request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
					mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
					require.NotPanics(t, func() {
						if entry == "mounted" {
							endpoints := &probe.Endpoints{Call: endpoint, Nothing: endpoint, Object: endpoint}
							server.Mount(mux, server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, encoder, handler))
							mux.ServeHTTP(response, request)
							return
						}
						var raw jsonrpc.RawRequest
						require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(body), &raw))
						var dispatch func(context.Context, *http.Request, *jsonrpc.RawRequest, http.ResponseWriter) error
						switch method {
						case "call":
							dispatch = server.NewCallHandler(endpoint, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, encoder, handler)
						case "nothing":
							dispatch = server.NewNothingHandler(endpoint, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, encoder, handler)
						case "object":
							dispatch = server.NewObjectHandler(endpoint, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, encoder, handler)
						}
						require.NoError(t, dispatch(request.Context(), request, &raw, response))
					})
					wantCalls := 1
					if strings.HasPrefix(mode, "decode-") {
						wantCalls = 0
					}
					require.Equal(t, wantCalls, calls)
					wantReports := 0
					if provided && mode != "decode-request" && mode != "endpoint-request" && mode != "success" {
						wantReports = 1
					}
					require.Equal(t, wantReports, reports)
					require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, response.Code)
					if strings.HasSuffix(mode, "notification") || strings.HasSuffix(mode, "encode") {
						require.Empty(t, response.Body.String())
						return
					}
					var envelope struct {
						ID    string `json:"id"`
						Error *struct {
							Code    int    `json:"code"`
							Message string `json:"message"`
						} `json:"error"`
						Result string `json:"result"`
					}
					require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &envelope))
					require.Equal(t, "one", envelope.ID)
					if mode == "success" {
						require.Nil(t, envelope.Error)
						require.Equal(t, "ok", envelope.Result)
					} else {
						require.NotNil(t, envelope.Error)
						want := -32603
						if mode == "decode-request" {
							want = -32602
						}
						require.Equal(t, want, envelope.Error.Code)
						require.NotEmpty(t, envelope.Error.Message)
						require.NotContains(t, response.Body.String(), cause.Error())
					}
				})
			}
		}
	}
}

func (e failureEncoder) Encode(any) error {
	return e.err
}
